typedef long long ll;

static string modAdd(int a, int b, int mod) {
    ll res = ((ll)(a % mod) + (b % mod)) % mod;
    if (res < 0) res += mod;
    return to_string((int)res);
}

static string modSub(int a, int b, int mod) {
    ll res = ((ll)(a % mod) - (b % mod) + mod) % mod;
    return to_string((int)res);
}

static string modMul(int a, int b, int mod) {
    ll res = ((ll)(a % mod) * (b % mod)) % mod;
    return to_string((int)res);
}

static int modPow(int base, int exp, int mod) {
    int result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
            ll temp = (ll)result * base % mod;
            result = (int)temp;
        }
        ll temp = (ll)base * base % mod;
        base = (int)temp;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

static string modDiv(int a, int b, int mod) {
    int inv = modPow(b, mod - 2, mod);
    ll res = ((ll)a * inv) % mod;
    if (res < 0) res += mod;
    return to_string((int)res);
}

static int gcd(int a, int b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        int t = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = t;
    }
    return a;
}

static int binarySearchLeftmost(int target, const vector<int>& arr) {
    int lo = 0, hi = (int)arr.size() - 1, ans = -1;
    while (lo <= hi) {
        int mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        if (arr[mid] < target) {
            ans = mid;
            lo = mid + 1;
        } else {
            hi = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

static vector<long long> logSumPowers(long long target, long long n) {
    long long i = 1;
    int count = 0;
    long long sum = 0;
    vector<long long> res(2);
    while (i < target) {
        sum += i;
        count++;
        if (sum == n) {
            res[0] = count;
            res[1] = sum;
            return res;
        }
        i *= 2;
    }
    res[0] = count;
    res[1] = sum;
    return res;
}

static void increment(map<int, int>& map, int key) {

}

static int binarySearchOptimized(const vector<int>& prefix, int start, int target, int n) {
    int lo = start + 1, hi = n - 1, ans = start;
    while (lo <= hi) {
        int mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
        int diff = prefix[mid] - prefix[start];
        if (diff == target) return mid;
        if (diff < target) {
            ans = mid;
            lo = mid + 1;
        } else {
            hi = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

static pair<long long, int> computeResult(const vector<int>& list) {
    long long total = 0;
    int minVal = INT_MAX;
    for (int x : list) {
        total += x;
        if (x < minVal) minVal = x;
    }
    return make_pair(total - minVal, minVal);
}

static int findMaxDivisor(map<int, int>& map, int num, int req) {
    int maxK = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i * i <= num; i++) {
        if (num % i == 0) {
            int d1 = i, d2 = num / i;
            increment(map, d1);
            if (d1 != d2) increment(map, d2);
            if (map[d1] == req) maxK = max(maxK, d1);
            if (map[d2] == req) maxK = max(maxK, d2);
        }
    }
    return maxK;
}

    int max = list[0];
    for (int x : list) if (x > max) max = x;
    return max;
}

static int findMin(const vector<int>& list) {
    int min = list[0];
    for (int x : list) if (x < min) min = x;
    return min;
